Name: Shardbloom Crystals
Author: BentleyTheModder1
Description:
[center][size=6][b][color=#b57edc]Shardbloom Crystals[/color][/b][/size]
[i]Fifteen glowing gem-flowers for your farmhouse[/i][/center]

[line]

[size=4][b]About[/b][/size]
Shardbloom Crystals adds [b]15 crystal decorations[/b] to Robin's Carpenter Shop. Each one is a 2x2 piece you can place in your home, outside, inside basically anywhere and they're always in stock, so buy as many as you like.

[size=4][b]The Crystals[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]500g:[/b] Topaz, Aquamarine[/*]
[*][b]600g:[/b] Jade, Citrine[/*]
[*][b]650g:[/b] Garnet, Rose Quartz, Turquoise[/*]
[*][b]700g:[/b] Onyx[/*]
[*][b]750g:[/b] Ruby, Emerald, Sapphire, Amethyst[/*]
[*][b]800g:[/b] Obsidian[/*]
[*][b]900g:[/b] Moonstone[/*]
[*][b]1,000g:[/b] Opal[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Special Letter[/b][/size]
The first morning after you install it, you'll get a one-time thank-you letter in your mailbox. It's a shoutout to [b]HB (HunnyBwat)[/b], whose idea inspired this mod.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]SMAPI[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] 2.9.1 or newer[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI and Content Patcher.[/*]
[*]Unzip [b]ShardbloomCrystals[/b] into your [b]Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Visit Robin's Carpenter Shop and look for the Shardblooms.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
This mod only adds new items and doesn't change any existing ones, so it should work alongside other mods. It works in multiplayer too; the letter is sent by the host.

[size=4][b]Uninstalling[/b][/size]
Remove the folder from your Mods folder. Any placed crystals will disappear from your save, so pick them up first if you want to keep your decor tidy.

[size=4][b]Credits[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Made by [b]Bentley Playz[/b][/*]
[*]Idea by [b]HB (HunnyBwat)[/b][/*]
[*]Thanks to Pathoschild for Content Patcher[/*]
[/list]
[center][i]Enjoy your crystals![/i][/center]
